title: POPCORN Witness Request v1
description: A privacy-preserving commitment request. POPCORN receives the digest, nonce, and optional predecessor digest; it does not receive the underlying payload.

nonce.description: Exactly 32 client-generated random bytes encoded as unpadded base64url. The client is responsible for uniqueness.

previous_attestation_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact previous compact JWS UTF-8 bytes, or null when this checkpoint has no predecessor.
